about: Showcase models (D1): models the user can review on the showcase page and race against. Not the game's default; promotion into packages/server/src/ai/models/ is by hand, after real races. Exam v2 numbers are the training run's own exam (102 races: demo, short, 100 random tracks; seed 1; 180 s) at that generation; skills are `npm run skills` (8 episodes per skill, seed 1).

models.label: Game default (bundled)
models.role: The model the game ships with today (packages/server/src/ai/models/default-model.json)
models.setup: legacy spec (4 inputs, no sensors, no controller), interim Dart-era training (48 generations, seed 2026)
